description: A small, wiry, scrappy goblinoid scavenger: ugly-cunning rather than cute, with quick hands, oversized pointed ears, a broad flattened nose, angular cheeks, and a wide sharp-toothed grin. Small narrow-chested humanoid with lean sinewy limbs, long quick fingers, slightly crouched posture, and light scavenger proportions rather than heroic or muscular anatomy. Mostly bare leathery-looking skin represented with clean line art; sparse hair only. No fur covering, fluffy cheeks, fuzzy limbs, or animal pelt silhouette.
